definitions.explanation: A movie produced outside Japan, especially from Western countries. Used to categorize films in movie listings, rental shops, and streaming services.
Painting done in Western techniques (oil painting, watercolor, etc.) as opposed to traditional Japanese-style painting.

examples.english: I'm the type who watches foreign movies with subtitles.

notes:
Has two distinct meanings depending on context.

SENSE 1 (film):
Contrasts with ⟦{邦画|ほうが}→邦画：14740_houga⟧ (Japanese film). In practice, {洋画|ようが} covers all non-Japanese films, not just Western ones, though the label originated from that distinction.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS (film):
- {洋画|ようが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{字幕|じまく}→字幕：04446_jimaku⟧ (subtitles for a foreign film)
- {洋画|ようが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{吹|ふ}き{替|か}え→吹き替え：05229_fukikae⟧ (dubbed foreign film)

SENSE 2 (painting):
Contrasts with ⟦{日本画|にほんが}→日本画：18225_nihonga⟧ (Japanese-style painting). Refers to Western art techniques like oil painting (⟦{油絵|あぶらえ}→油絵：07076_aburae⟧) and watercolor (⟦{水彩画|すいさいが}→水彩画：07077_suisaiga⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS (painting):
- {洋画家|ようがか} (Western-style painter)
- {洋画|ようが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技法|ぎほう}→技法：12800_gihou⟧ (Western painting techniques)
